verdicts.quote: Endpoint `POST /tickets/:id/merge`, body `{ "into": "T-0001" }` (`:id` is the duplicate, `into` the surviving ticket). … 200 with the duplicate ticket … an unknown field is 400 `invalid`.
Endpoint `POST /tickets/:id/merge`, body `{ "into": "T-0001" }` (`:id` is the duplicate, `into` the surviving ticket).
now `status: "closed"` and `mergedInto: "<into>"` … Invariant: a ticket with `mergedInto` is `closed` and the target exists.
verdicts.missing: Whether later edits are allowed and how a transition or reopen request on a merged ticket is handled.

verdicts.quote: The surviving ticket is unchanged (title, priority, status, `updated`). … it records the link only: the ticket's own fields stay as they were
now `status: "closed"` and `mergedInto: "<into>"` … `GET /tickets/:id` of a merged ticket still answers.
verdicts.missing: Whether the collection includes the absorbed ticket in unfiltered results and which status filters include it.

verdicts.quote: Failure (409 `conflict`, message names the reason): merging a ticket into itself; a duplicate that is already closed (including already merged); a surviving ticket that is closed.
verdicts.missing: Whether a resolved ticket is mergeable as the duplicate or as the survivor.

verdicts.quote: unknown `:id` or unknown `into` is 404 `not_found`; body not an object, missing or non-ticket-id `into`, or an unknown field is 400 `invalid`.
verdicts.missing: The response code for a malformed source path ID and which offending ID or field the error message identifies.

verdicts.quote: no chains: because closed tickets are refused as a target, a ticket merged into a ticket cannot be merged into a closed one.
verdicts.missing: If A was merged into B, the closed-target rule blocks B into A. It leaves the handling of B into an open C undecided, including whether to refuse it or update A's link.

verdicts.quote: 409 `conflict` … a duplicate that is already closed (including already merged) … A refused merge changes nothing: no audit entry, no notification, no save.
The surviving ticket is unchanged (title, priority, status, `updated`). … the surviving ticket gets one entry, action `ticket.merge_received`
the service has no auth, so any caller naming itself in `X-Actor` (default `system`) may merge … no authentication or role check is added

`mergedInto: "<into>"` … with `DATA_FILE`, a merged ticket reloads with `status`, `mergedInto`, and the audit entries intact. … `version` stays 1; a data file written before this change loads unchanged (no `mergedInto` means not merged)
a record whose `mergedInto` is present but not a ticket id, or names no ticket, is refused as a corrupt data file. … a ticket with `mergedInto` is `closed` and the target exists.
verdicts.missing: Whether loading rejects cycles and status/link mismatches, and how the refusal message identifies the offending record.

verdicts.quote: action `ticket.merged`, the request's actor … `{ status: {from, to: "closed"}, mergedInto: {from: null, to: "<into>"} }` … `ticket.merge_received`, changes `{ mergedFrom: {from: null, to: "<duplicate id>"} }` … Visible in `GET /tickets/:id/audit` of each.
a merge is applied atomically in memory (both tickets and the audit entries change in one store call, then one save)
verdicts.missing: Whether the outbox entry commits with the tickets and audits, and whether a failed save or crash leaves only the complete old or complete new state.

verdicts.quote: one `ticket.merged` outbox notification to the duplicate's requester, key `ticket.merged:<id>`, rendered by a new template in `src/templates.js` that names both ticket ids. … the surviving ticket's requester is not notified
verdicts.missing: What the template says beyond naming both IDs, and whether existing pending notifications for the absorbed ticket are delivered, cancelled or updated.

verdicts.quote: The operators' CLI stays read-only: `show` prints a merged ticket normally and shows `mergedInto` in its details; `list` and `list --raw` columns are unchanged
Preserved: all existing endpoints, ticket fields and lifecycle
`list` and `list --raw` columns are unchanged (the weekly report reads them by position).
verdicts.missing: Whether the weekly report counts an absorbed ticket in the overall total and in the closed-ticket count.

verdicts.quote: Confirmed by store and API tests. … `docs/api.md` documents the endpoint … a decision record (docs/decisions/0009) … `CHANGELOG.md` gains a 1.5.0 section and `package.json` version 1.5.0. … Dependencies: none added … in one store call
